title: Tada
desc: This story revolves around Balraj Rana who lost his father to the underworld mafia, and now himself dons the mantle of a dreaded gangster.

title: Gandhi My Father
desc: The turbulent and troubled life of Gandhi's son, Harilal, who at once tried to support his father's ideology, while simultaneously trying to create a life for himself, separate from his family name.

title: Baazi
desc: A chief minister delegates the task of locating culprits behind a scandal to a police inspector with a reputation for tackling assassins. However, the inspector is framed for murder and must find a way to prove himself innocent.

title: Jhansi Ki Rani Lakshmibai
desc: Jhansi Ki Rani Lakshmibai tells the heroic story of Rani Lakshmibai, a fearless queen who led a valiant resistance against British rule. Defying all odds, she became a symbol of courage, sacrifice, and India's fight for freedom.
